data.body: **[P2] MDC preservation failures can replace the durable execution outcome.** If the snapshot fails, invocation-end hooks are skipped; if `MDC.clear()` or `setContextMap()` fails after the hooks, that exception escapes the finalizer and converts an already selected success or suspension into an invocation failure. Make nonfatal MDC snapshot/restoration failures best-effort around end dispatch—logging them without replacing the result—while retaining JVM-fatal propagation, and add a full `execute()` regression for this inner restoration path.
